messages:
Maya: Heads-up 3 customer asked for a Console view that ties estimated spend to traces so infra can diagnose expensive tails. Minimal SDK changes preferred.
Liam: Do they need exact billing or an engineer-facing estimate?
Maya: Estimate is fine for now. They want to find 'who' and 'why' when cost spikes.
Priya: Plan: add span tags `model`, `route`, `tenant_hash` and a root tag `est_cost`. Dashboard aggregates by those.
Noah: Sampling: default 1% kept. Add dynamic sampler: force 100% for spans where `est_cost` > $threshold or tenant in canary list.
Zoe: UI: "Top estimated spenders" table, pivot by model/route, timepicker, and a drilldown button that opens trace explorer focused on cost spans. Tooltip clarifies estimates.
Dina: Launch criteria: 1) Console table + pivoting; 2) trace linkouts; 3) export opt-in (BigQuery) with agreed schema; 4) docs and opt-in checklist.
Liam: Proposed export row: `ts, tenant_hash, model, route, tokens_est, est_cost, trace_id, batch_id`. I can own schema and versioning.
Priya: SDK change: optional `obs_meta` param. Example:
```
client.request(prompt, obs_meta={"model":"rwd-2b","route":"/v1/chat"})
span.set_tag('est_cost', 0.0072)
```
Maya: Rough estimates?
Priya: Backend collection + export schema: ~2w. UI MVP: ~1.5w. SDKs: small patches across langs, a few days each.
Noah: Infra: ~1w to support high-sample canaries and a retention cap for non-canary tenants. Need an SLO for trace ingestion cost.
Liam: Privacy: only hashed tenant IDs. Exports disabled by default, opt-in for enterprise. Legal review required.
Dina: I'll run legal and compliance check and produce a launch checklist. Exports gated behind signed agreement.
Zoe: Success metrics: estimate vs billing median delta <20% for top tenants, discoverability improvement in canary trials (time-to-root-cause down 40%), dashboard median latency <250ms.
Priya: Phases: Phase 0 add `model`+`route` tags (hotfix). Phase 1 add `est_cost` tags + internal dashboard. Phase 2 GA exports and SDK ergonomics.
Maya: Rollout: internal canary (2 customers) with 100% sampling for them, then iterate.
Noah: Add runbook to disable high-sample path if ingestion cost spikes. Also reconciliation job comparing estimates to billing after each billing window.
Liam: +1 to feature flagging and audit logs for exports.
Maya: Ok owners: Liam=schema/export, Priya=SDK+collection, Noah=ingestion+samples, Zoe=UX, Dina=legal+launch checklist, Maya=PM. I'll send a follow-up invite.
observability-bot: Created OBS-801 "Tenant cost + trace linking" assigned to Maya, Priya, Liam, Noah, Zoe, Dina.
